fields.title: [ticket-api] create_ticket accepts off-schema state values, and health_check does not detect the resulting frozen tickets

fields.acceptance_criteria: create_ticket rejects (or normalizes) a state argument that is not a member of the resolved ticket type schema's states list, with a clear error naming the invalid value and legal set; a unit/integration test asserts create_ticket cannot produce a ticket whose state is absent from its type schema; health_check (and health_check --all) flags any ticket whose current state is not a member of its resolved type schema's states list as a distinct finding kind (e.g. off_schema_state); a regression test reproduces this exact scenario (create/patch a ticket into an off-schema state, then assert health_check reports it); existing store data is unaffected by the fix landing, no bulk migration required
fields.title: [ticket-api] create_ticket accepts off-schema state values, and health_check does not detect the resulting frozen tickets
